remarks: Welcome to Glen Oak! This spacious townhouse-style condo offers an inviting open floorplan, perfect for modern living and entertaining. The main level features a living room with a cozy fireplace, seamlessly flowing into the dining room, both adorned with sliding glass doors that lead to a charming brick patio-an ideal setting for entertaining. Updated kitchen with SS appliances. Completing the main level are a spacious powder room & laundry room. The upper level features a primary bedroom with sliders opening to a private deck. The adjoining large bathroom features dual entries from both the primary bedroom and hallway, enhancing privacy and convenience. A spacious second bedroom offers versatility and ample closet space. Attic access provides more ample storage space. Situated within walking distance to the train, restaurants, and shopping, this home combines convenience with comfort. Move right in and make this meticulously maintained residence your own! Highest and Best Offers by 6:00 pm on Thursday June 13th. All offers are to be in writing with Preapproval or Proof of Funds. Please include any/all Terms and Conditions [contingencies] in your offer.
